# Pack — fat pipes / thin local map
Local node = RIB, manifests, golden set, switchboard, queue, receipts. Vast = burst GPU, bulk weights, bulk corpus, scratch. Fiber moves selected artifacts; it does not make ephemeral storage durable. Every remote job has placement, budget, TTL, transfer estimate, output hash, and destroy/retain decision. Keep the local machine small until measurements prove storage or GPU is the bottleneck. Question: what is the cheapest reversible job that proves RIB -> Docker -> Vast -> receipt -> rebuild? Falsifier: the job completes, but no one can reproduce it from the returned map.

>be the offload plan
>call Vast a burst GPU and the local node a thin map
>good, but a fat pipe is not a magic carpet and ephemeral scratch is not a vault
>the missing piece is a measured transfer envelope plus retain/destroy decision
>next: tiny Docker image, tiny corpus slice, one remote run, returned hash, local rebuild
>falsifier: the job finishes and nobody can reproduce it from the map
